Head Injuries
CANADIAN CTB RULE FOR MINOR TBI
OTHER INJURIES – IMAGING TO CONSIDER
Isolated Head Injury
If the patient has sustained an isolated injury to the head (eg hit on head), you can request an isolated CTB 
(if it is indicated)
Polytrauma Head + Neck
If the patient has sustained a polytrauma mechanism, or the GCS is low + you cannot assess C-Spine, please 
ALSO request a CT-C-spine along with CTB
Skull fractures 
Request a CTB with bony windows (to allow for better imaging of skull bones)
Facial Fractures 
If the patient has concomitant facial fractures and is getting a CTB, please request additional CT facial views 
(+/- reconstruction)
Isolated Nasal bone fracture
No need for CT scan: request dedicated nasal bone X-rays
Isolated mandible fracture
Request a dedicated mandible X-ray (panoramic view is best)
